title: Shruti Haasan's Airport Look In A Cotton Saree Offers Monsoon Fashion Goals | Lifestyle News - News18
text:
Shruti Haasan opted for a cotton saree in her recent airport look, showcasing the comfort of ethnic wear in monsoon. The Coolie star, who has a wide collection of sarees in her wardrobe, picked a green and black one for her latest appearance. Donning the six yards of elegance, Shruti indeed proved what she prioritises comfort while travelling. Ditching all the glittery picks, Shruti Haasan opted for a simple green and black one. The saree that seamlessly complemented her toned figure featured bold black horizontal stripes all over the piece, adding a striking touch. She teamed the saree with a simple, three-quarter-sleeved blouse with a round neckline.
Decoding Shruti Haasan’s Airport Look Keeping her look absolutely minimal, the actress opted for only a pair of simple Kolhapuri chappals. Silver earrings and a sleek, double-layered neckpiece were the only accessories.
For makeup, Shruti Haasan went for a dewy foundation base, which was enhanced with a dollop of blush, giving a fresh glow to her face. Peachy nude lipstick and a black bindi worked as her signature style.
advetisement She left her hair middle-parted and open, allowing it to cascade down her shoulders effortlessly. It was Shruti Haasan’s bright smile that sealed the look.
When Shruti Haasan Wore A Baby Pink-Hued Silk Saree Shruti Haasan has once again charmed fashion lovers with her beautiful saree choices. In the past, she made a stylish statement at an event with her father Kamal Haasan wearing a lovely baby pink saree.
Shruti’s saree featured a delicate embroidered border, elevating the entire look. She teamed it with a matching-coloured blouse and pearl jewellery, which included a chic necklace and a pair of stud earrings.
Subtle makeup, including a highlighted foundation base and glossy lipstick, added an oomph factor to her overall charm. Shruti Haasan went for thin strokes of eyeliner and a brown eyeshadow. Side-parted, half-done, open hairstyle maximised her beauty.
